summary_md: **CF长风 ([@cfenghub](https://x.com/cfenghub/status/2116180999210221672))** explains **Xiaomi-OCR-0**, a 0.8B document-understanding VLM fine-tuned from Qwen3.5-0.8B that outputs Markdown with LaTeX and tables, extracts structured JSON and answers document questions, shipping an MCP server and agent skill; better than PaddleOCR for understanding but not for fast text localization ([SeerRay-Lab/Xiaomi-OCR-0](https://github.com/SeerRay-Lab/Xiaomi-OCR-0)).
relevance: Tiny local document VLM with agent integrations.
